task_title: Floor 1 unlocked UX overlap and readability cleanup

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review compared coordinator-state-machine, unified character shell tabs, and overlay-priority registry approaches. Kept incremental scene-level coordination for this slice while resolving blocker concerns through follow-up fixes in input gating, panel exclusivity, and touch-safe close behavior.

rounds.notes: Resolved all reported defects: removed equipment->inventory auto-open coupling, allowed map-to-panel toggles by unlocking map from uiLock gate, auto-closed inventory when leaving safe context, blocked key-E interactions while blocking surfaces are open, fixed minimap Escape visibility leak under masterHidden, and corrected tooltip center-anchor placement math.
Cross-model adjudication accepted all concrete runtime concerns and verified fixes were applied in MainGameScene, HudMinimap, and item-tooltip without broadening scope.
